## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2026-01-23: Unexecuted draft TRA filed as Exhibit 10.6 to S-1/A Amendment No. 1 with blank preamble date
- 2026-02-10: Up-C IPO closes (Nasdaq under MWH); TRA executed at 85% sharing rate with SOLV Energy Holdings LLC, the TRA Party Representative, and the Continuing Equity Owners and Blocker Shareholders
- 2026-02-12: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.2 to closing 8-K
- 2026-03-31: First quarterly balance sheet recognizes $172.3M long-term TRA liability with offset to additional paid-in capital

## Explanation

SOLV Energy, Inc. executed a Tax Receivable Agreement on February 10, 2026 at its Up-C IPO close on Nasdaq, paying 85% of cumulative net realized tax benefits to the Continuing Equity Owners and Blocker Shareholders (the pre-IPO equityholders of SOLV Energy Holdings LLC, controlled by American Securities funds). Covered attributes are Section 754 basis adjustments from exchanges, Reorganization Transferred Basis, Blocker Attributes including pre-IPO net operating losses, and imputed interest on TRA payments. The initial long-term TRA liability of $172.3M was recognized at the first post-IPO balance-sheet date with a corresponding reduction to additional paid-in capital. The contract is one quarter old as of the May 2026 Q1 10-Q; no amendments, restatements, or terminations have occurred. See `contract_log.md` for the executed text and the unexecuted draft.
